name: research_pass
title: A product ask is looked into before it is planned; the plan is a menu of pieces with evidence

steps.say: I want to build something similar to growthfactor.ai, for car washes in the US, scoring sites from public data. It's for me, looking at sites for a car wash I might buy or build; it should help me pick which sites to pursue; today I look at listings by hand and I have no scorecard or site process. Look into it and propose it.
steps.reply:
I'll look into how site-selection tools like this actually score locations — what public data is reliably available nationwide (traffic, demographics, competition), what a lender-style underwriting memo weighs, and what's realistic to automate vs. leave as manual input. This runs in the background for a few minutes and I'll bring back a plan here; let me know if you want me to stop it.

For context: you built almost exactly this earlier today (TxDOT traffic data, scored an Austin address 69/100) then deleted the whole module. I'm treating this as a clean redo rather than assuming why — if ther

steps.decline_plan: Car Wash Site Scoring (US, public data)

checks.why: Pass 'Car Wash Site Scoring (US, public data)' is done (verdict partial: 58 findings from 37 pages; 13 pieces on the plan; 6 findings dropped, their pages did not answer.); 3 looks: Site-selection products for car washes and similar retail/QSR site scoring tools; Car wash site selection and lender underwriting practice; Open public data sources for nationwide site scoring (traffic, demographics, competition).

Plans: Car Wash Site Scoring (US, public data) (proposed). 13 pieces: kept: Address → location data (keep, now); kept: Demographics (population, income, households) (keep, needs); kept: Traffic count (AADT) near the site (keep, now); kept: Competitor density (1/3/5-mile rings) (keep, now); kept: Weighted 0-100 scorecard, by format (keep, now); kept: Keyless/unattended flag (keep, now); kept: Lender-style memo (keep, now); choice: Lot size, shape and access (manual) (keep, needs); choice: Zoning and environmental gate (manual checklist) (keep, not_yet); choice: Auto-score new Deal Tracker listings (defer, needs); wont: Paid foot-traffic data (Placer.ai/SafeGraph) (skip, not_yet); wont: Paid nationwide parcel/zoning data (Regrid) (skip, not_yet); wont: Natural-language "judge the site" evaluator (skip, not_yet). Kinds missing: none. Distinct findings cited with a page that answered: 21.
Plans: Car Wash Site Scoring (US, public data) (declined).
